name: मुख्यमंत्री लाड़ली बहना योजना

hi.name: मुख्यमंत्री लाड़ली बहना योजना
hi.shortDescription: मध्य प्रदेश की पात्र महिलाओं को ₹1,250 प्रति माह की प्रत्यक्ष वित्तीय सहायता।

description: मुख्यमंत्री लाड़ली बहना योजना मध्य प्रदेश शासन की एक प्रमुख सामाजिक कल्याण योजना है, जिसका उद्देश्य प्रदेश की महिलाओं को आर्थिक रूप से सशक्त बनाना, उनके स्वास्थ्य व पोषण में सुधार करना और परिवार स्तर पर उनके निर्णयों में प्रभावी भूमिका सुनिश्चित करना है।
shortDescription: Monthly financial aid of ₹1,250 to eligible women residents of Madhya Pradesh to foster economic independence and nutritional security.
benefits: Direct benefit transfer (DBT) of ₹1,250 per month into bank accounts
Regular monthly financial support on the 10th of every month
Financial independence for personal, medical, and family needs
eligibility: Resident women of MP aged 21 to 60 years. Family annual income must be below ₹2.5 Lakh. Family should not be income-tax payee or have any member as regular government employee.
documents: Active Bank Account with DBT and Aadhaar Linkage
Active Mobile Number registered with Aadhaar
applicationSteps: Complete Samagra e-KYC online or at CSC/Kiosk centre.
Visit camp organised at Gram Panchayat / Ward level.
Submit application with Samagra ID and Aadhaar photo match.
Collect printed acknowledgement slip from operator.
Verify DBT status on official portal cmladlibahna.mp.gov.in.
officialDepartment: Department of Women & Child Development, Govt of Madhya Pradesh
source: Government of Madhya Pradesh Official Portal

name: लाड़ली बहना गैस रिफिल योजना
name_en: Ladli Behna LPG Cylinder Refill Subsidy Scheme

hi.name: लाड़ली बहना गैस रिफिल योजना
hi.shortDescription: लाड़ली बहना योजना व उज्ज्वला योजना की हितग्राही महिलाओं को ₹450 में एलपीजी गैस सिलेंडर।

description: इस योजना के अंतर्गत मध्य प्रदेश की लाड़ली बहनों तथा प्रधानमंत्री उज्ज्वला योजना (PMUY) की पात्र महिला उपभोक्ताओं को घरेलू एलपीजी गैस सिलेंडर मात्र ₹450 में उपलब्ध कराया जाता है। शेष अनुदान राशि राज्य सरकार द्वारा सीधे डीबीटी के माध्यम से बैंक खाते में हस्तांतरित की जाती है।
shortDescription: Provision of domestic LPG cylinder refills at a subsidized price of ₹450 for Ladli Behna and PMUY beneficiaries in MP.
benefits: LPG cylinder refill available at subsidized price of ₹450
Difference in refill cost refunded directly via DBT to bank account
Reduction in household expenses and promotion of smoke-free kitchens
eligibility: Registered beneficiaries of Ladli Behna Yojana or PM Ujjwala Yojana possessing domestic LPG connection registered in their name in Madhya Pradesh.
incomeLimit: As per Ladli Behna / PMUY norms
documents: LPG Connection Consumer Number & Oil Company Name (IOCL/BPCL/HPCL)
Bank Account details linked with DBT
applicationSteps: Visit nearest Gram Panchayat, Ward office, or MP Online Kiosk.
Submit LPG Consumer Number and Ladli Behna Registration ID.
Operator links your LPG connection on the portal.
Purchase cylinder from your gas agency at regular market price.
Subsidy amount credited back to your bank account via DBT.
officialDepartment: Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Protection Dept, Govt of Madhya Pradesh

name: लाड़ली लक्ष्मी योजना 2.0

hi.name: लाड़ली लक्ष्मी योजना 2.0
hi.shortDescription: बालिकाओं के जन्म, शिक्षा व सशक्तिकरण हेतु ₹1,43,000 तक का वित्तीय आश्वासन।

description: बालिकाओं के प्रति समाज में सकारात्मक सोच को बढ़ावा देने, लिंगानुपात में सुधार, बाल विवाह की रोकथाम और बालिकाओं की उच्च शिक्षा को सुनिश्चित करने हेतु मध्य प्रदेश सरकार द्वारा संचालित प्रतिष्ठित योजना।
shortDescription: Comprehensive financial support package of up to ₹1.43 Lakh supporting girl child education and welfare from birth up to marriage/graduation.
benefits: Financial assurance certificate of ₹1,43,000 issued at registration
One-time lump sum incentive of ₹25,000 on taking admission in college/undergraduate degree
Final payment of ₹1 Lakh on completing 21 years of age without early marriage
eligibility: Girl child born in Madhya Pradesh after January 1, 2006. Parents must be MP domicile and non-income tax payers. Maximum 2 children in family (with sterilization adopted after 2nd child).
documents: Passport sized photo of girl child with parents
applicationSteps: Visit Anganwadi Center within 1 year of child birth or apply via MP Online / ladlilaxmi.mp.gov.in.
Upload birth certificate, Samagra ID, and parental declaration.
Project Officer verifies documents and issues Ladli Laxmi Assurance Certificate.
Subsequent educational scholarships disbursed automatically into beneficiary account.
officialDepartment: Department of Women & Child Development, Govt of Madhya Pradesh
source: Government of Madhya Pradesh Official Portal

name: मुख्यमंत्री कन्या विवाह / निकाह योजना
name_en: Mukhya Mantri Kanya Vivah / Nikah Yojana

hi.name: मुख्यमंत्री कन्या विवाह / निकाह योजना
hi.shortDescription: गरीब व जरूरतमंद कन्याओं के सामूहिक विवाह हेतु ₹51,000 की आर्थिक सहायता।

description: गरीब, जरूरतमंद, निराश्रित परिवारों की कन्याओं, विधवा और परित्यक्ता महिलाओं के वैवाहिक खर्च में सहायता प्रदान करने के लिए सामूहिक विवाह सम्मेलनों के माध्यम से वित्तीय अनुदान उपलब्ध कराने की योजना।
shortDescription: Financial assistance of ₹51,000 per bride for marriage ceremonies conducted via mass wedding events.
benefits: Total financial assistance of ₹51,000 per eligible bride
₹49,000 deposited directly into bride's account for household setup
₹6,000 allocated for marriage event organisation and arrangements
eligibility: Bride must be 18+ years and groom 21+ years. Family must be resident of Madhya Pradesh and belong to BPL, destitute, or low income category.
documents: Age proof of bride and groom (Birth certificate / 10th marksheet / Aadhaar)
Samagra ID and BPL Card / Income Certificate
Bank Account details of the bride
applicationSteps: Apply at local Gram Panchayat, Janpad Panchayat or Urban Local Body office at least 15 days before the mass wedding.
Submit joint application form with age and domicile documents.
Verification by local revenue/panchayat authorities.
Participate in designated mass marriage event.
Grant credited directly into bride's bank account.
officialDepartment: Department of Social Justice and Disabled Welfare, Govt of MP
source: Government of Madhya Pradesh Official Portal

name: मुख्यमंत्री किसान कल्याण योजना

hi.name: मुख्यमंत्री किसान कल्याण योजना
hi.shortDescription: मध्य प्रदेश के पीएम-किसान पात्र किसानों को अतिरिक्त ₹6,000 प्रति वर्ष की सहायता।

description: मध्य प्रदेश सरकार द्वारा पीएम किसान सम्मान निधि के अतिरिक्त प्रदेश के किसानों को वार्षिक ₹6,000 की वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की जाती है, जिससे कुल मिलाकर किसानों को प्रति वर्ष ₹12,000 (केंद्र से ₹6,000 + राज्य से ₹6,000) प्राप्त होते हैं।
shortDescription: Direct cash support of ₹6,000/year in installments to PM-KISAN beneficiary landholding farmers in Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: ₹6,000 additional annual assistance disbursed in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000
Combined with PM-KISAN, farmers receive total ₹12,000 annually
Helps meet input costs like seeds, fertilizers, and agricultural equipment
eligibility: Farmers of Madhya Pradesh who are landholders and registered beneficiaries of PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi Yojana.
documents: Bank Account linked with Aadhaar & NPCI DBT
applicationSteps: Ensure eligibility under Central PM-KISAN scheme.
Verify land records on SAARA portal (saara.mp.gov.in) with Patwari.
Patwari validates landholding status and updates portal.
Installment credited directly into bank account via DBT.
officialDepartment: Revenue Department, Govt of Madhya Pradesh

name: बलराम ताल योजना

hi.name: बलराम ताल योजना
hi.shortDescription: खेत में जल संरक्षण व तालाब निर्माण हेतु किसानों को 75% तक अनुदान।

description: खेतों में बारिश का पानी संचित करने और भूजल स्तर बढ़ाने के उद्देश्य से किसानों को अपने खेतों में बलराम ताल (खेत तालाब) निर्माण हेतु लागत पर 40% से 75% तक सरकारी अनुदान दिया जाता है।
shortDescription: Subsidies ranging from 40% to 75% (up to ₹1 Lakh) for constructing farm ponds to harvest rainwater for irrigation in MP.
benefits: Small & Marginal Farmers (SC/ST): 75% grant up to ₹1,00,000
Small & Marginal Farmers (General/OBC): 50% grant up to ₹80,000
General Category Other Farmers: 40% grant up to ₹80,000
Secures irrigation water for Rabi and Kharif crops
eligibility: Farmers of Madhya Pradesh having cultivable land where a water harvesting structure is feasible.
applicationSteps: Apply online on Farmers Welfare portal dbt.mpdage.org.
Submit land and location details with soil/water report.
Field inspection by Agricultural Engineering official.
Post-construction verification with geo-tagging.
Subsidy credited to farmer bank account.
officialDepartment: Farmers Welfare and Agriculture Development Dept, MP

name: सूरजधारा योजना

hi.name: सूरजधारा योजना
hi.shortDescription: एससी/एसटी के लघु एवं सीमांत किसानों को दलहनी-तिलहनी उन्नत बीजों पर 75% अनुदान।

description: अनुसूचित जाति एवं अनुसूचित जनजाति के लघु एवं सीमांत कृषकों को लाभकारी दलहन एवं तिलहन फसलों के प्रमाणित व उन्नत बीज उपलब्ध कराकर उनकी फसल उत्पादकता एवं आय में वृद्धि करने की योजना।
shortDescription: 75% seed replacement subsidy on high-yield pulses and oilseeds for SC and ST small/marginal farmers in Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: 75% financial subsidy on certified seed kits of pulses and oilseeds
Seed exchange facility with local improved varieties
Technical guidance and training by Agriculture Extension Officers
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers of MP belonging to SC or ST categories holding valid land ownership records.
applicationSteps: Contact Rural Agriculture Extension Officer (RAEO) or Janpad Panchayat.
Register details on MP Agriculture DBT portal.
Receive seed allocation voucher.
Collect certified seeds from designated cooperative society/seed store.
officialDepartment: Department of Agriculture, Govt of Madhya Pradesh

name: भावांतर भुगतान योजना

hi.name: भावांतर भुगतान योजना
hi.shortDescription: मंडी भाव और समर्थन मूल्य के अंतर की राशि किसानों के बैंक खाते में।

description: कृषि उपजों के बाजार मूल्यों में गिरावट के दौरान किसानों को वित्तीय सुरक्षा देने के उद्देश्य से न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य (MSP) अथवा मॉडल दर और किसान द्वारा मंडी में बेची गई वास्तविक दर के अंतर का भुगतान सीधे बैंक खाते में करने की योजना।
shortDescription: Price deficit compensation scheme providing payout of the gap between market auction price and minimum support price.
benefits: Direct compensation for market rate deficit into bank account
Protection from distress selling during bumper crop seasons
Transparent auction records linked via APMC Mandi e-portal
eligibility: Farmers of Madhya Pradesh cultivating notified crops registered on the portal during the sowing window.
documents: Mandi sales slip (Anubandh Patra & Bhugtan Patra)
applicationSteps: Register notified crop on MP e-Uparjan portal within specified dates.
Sell produce at designated APMC Mandi.
Collect official mandi receipt with biometric verification.
Deficit amount calculated and disbursed to bank account via DBT.
officialDepartment: Farmers Welfare & Agriculture Development Dept, MP

name: मुख्यमंत्री सीखो-कमाओ योजना (MMSKY)

hi.name: मुख्यमंत्री सीखो-कमाओ योजना
hi.shortDescription: युवाओं को कौशल प्रशिक्षण के साथ ₹8,000 से ₹10,000 प्रतिमाह स्टाइपेंड।

description: मध्य प्रदेश के 18 से 29 वर्ष के शिक्षित युवाओं को औद्योगिक एवं व्यावसायिक प्रतिष्ठानों में 'ऑन-द-जॉब ट्रेनिंग' (OJT) प्रदान करने और प्रशिक्षण अवधि में ₹8,000 से ₹10,000 प्रतिमाह स्टाइपेंड उपलब्ध कराने की महत्वाकांक्षी योजना।
shortDescription: On-the-job industrial skill training program offering monthly stipends between ₹8,000 and ₹10,000 to youth in MP.
benefits: 12th Pass trainees receive ₹8,000 per month stipend
ITI pass trainees receive ₹8,500 per month stipend
Diploma holders receive ₹9,000 per month stipend
Graduates / Postgraduates receive ₹10,000 per month stipend
75% stipend funded by MP Govt, 25% by enterprise; SCVT/NCVT certification
eligibility: Permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh aged 18 to 29 years. Minimum qualification: 12th pass, ITI, Diploma, or Higher Education degree.
documents: Bank Account linked with Aadhaar DBT
applicationSteps: Register on official MMSKY portal mmsky.mp.gov.in as Candidate.
Complete profile and select preferred vocational sectors and districts.
Browse vacancies offered by registered industrial enterprises.
Apply for training positions and accept training contract.
Undergo training and receive monthly stipend directly into bank account.
officialDepartment: Technical Education, Skill Development and Employment Dept, MP
source: MMSKY Official Portal Govt of MP

name: संत रविदास स्वरोजगार योजना

hi.name: संत रविदास स्वरोजगार योजना
hi.shortDescription: अनुसूचित जाति के युवाओं को ₹1 लाख से ₹50 लाख तक का ऋण व 5% ब्याज अनुदान।

description: मध्य प्रदेश के अनुसूचित जाति (SC) वर्ग के युवाओं को नवीन उद्यम, सेवा अथवा व्यवसाय स्थापित करने के लिए बैंकों के माध्यम से रियायती ब्याज दर पर ऋण और 5% वार्षिक ब्याज अनुदान प्रदान करने वाली योजना।
shortDescription: Financial loans from ₹1 Lakh to ₹50 Lakh with 5% interest subsidy for SC entrepreneurs in MP.
benefits: Manufacturing Units: Loan up to ₹50 Lakh
Service & Retail Units: Loan from ₹1 Lakh to ₹25 Lakh
5% annual interest subsidy for 5 years
Credit guarantee fee borne by the State Government
eligibility: Resident of MP belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) category aged 18 to 45 years with minimum 8th class educational qualification.
documents: SC Caste Certificate issued by competent authority
applicationSteps: Apply on MP MSME Portal msme.mponline.gov.in.
Upload business project report and caste credentials.
District Task Force Committee reviews and recommends to participating bank.
Bank sanction and disbursement with credit guarantee.
Quarterly interest subsidy credited by State Government.
officialDepartment: SC Welfare Department / MSME Dept, MP

name: मुख्यमंत्री उद्यम क्रांति योजना

hi.name: मुख्यमंत्री उद्यम क्रांति योजना
hi.shortDescription: 12वीं पास युवाओं को उद्योग हेतु ₹50 लाख व सेवा क्षेत्र हेतु ₹25 लाख तक का ऋण व 3% ब्याज अनुदान।

description: प्रदेश के शिक्षित युवाओं को स्वयं का उद्योग, सेवा अथवा व्यवसाय स्थापित करने हेतु वित्तीय सहायता उपलब्ध कराना, जिसमें राज्य सरकार द्वारा बैंक ऋण पर 3% वार्षिक ब्याज अनुदान तथा बैंक गारंटी शुल्क का 7 वर्ष तक वहन किया जाता है।
shortDescription: Collateral-free subsidized loans up to ₹50 Lakh with 3% interest subsidy for setting up manufacturing and service enterprises in MP.
benefits: Manufacturing sector: Loan from ₹1 Lakh up to ₹50 Lakh
Service & Trading sector: Loan from ₹1 Lakh up to ₹25 Lakh
3% per annum interest subsidy for maximum 7 years
Full guarantee coverage under CGTMSE paid by state government
eligibility: Resident of Madhya Pradesh aged 18 to 40 years. Minimum 12th pass. Family income not exceeding ₹12 Lakh per year. Not a defaulter with any financial institution.
documents: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, CIBIL Report
applicationSteps: Submit application on samast.mponline.gov.in portal.
Select desired business sector and preferred bank branch.
Scrutiny by District Industries Centre (DIC).
Sanction of loan by bank with government guarantee.
Release of subsidy upon successful business setup.
officialDepartment: Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME) Dept, MP

name: मुख्यमंत्री मेधावी विद्यार्थी योजना (MMVY)

hi.name: मुख्यमंत्री मेधावी विद्यार्थी योजना
hi.shortDescription: 12वीं में 70%+ अंक पाने वाले मेधावियों की मेडिकल, इंजीनियरिंग व उच्च शिक्षा की पूरी फीस सरकार भरेगी।

description: मध्य प्रदेश के प्रतिभावान विद्यार्थियों को उच्च शिक्षा (इंजीनियरिंग, मेडिकल, विधि, प्रबंधन आदि) में प्रवेश लेने पर उनकी संपूर्ण शिक्षण शुल्क (ट्यूशन फीस) राज्य सरकार द्वारा वहन की जाती है।
shortDescription: Complete tuition fee payment for meritorious MP students enrolled in premier professional courses (IIT, NIT, MBBS, NLU, etc.).
benefits: 100% tuition fee reimbursement for government and private colleges
Covers engineering (JEE Rank up to 1.5 Lakh), medical (NEET admissions), CLAT, and traditional degrees
Direct settlement of fees with educational institutions
eligibility: Resident of MP. Scored 70% or more in MP Board or 85% or more in CBSE/ICSE in Class 12. Family annual income less than ₹6,00,000.
documents: College Admission Allotment Letter & Fee Receipt
applicationSteps: Visit MP Scholarship Portal scholarshipportal.mp.nic.in.
Register as MMVY applicant with Samagra ID and Aadhaar.
Fill college admission details and upload verification documents.
College nodal officer verifies the application online.
State Department sanctions fee directly to institution.
officialDepartment: Department of Higher Education, Govt of Madhya Pradesh

name: गांव की बेटी योजना

hi.name: गांव की बेटी योजना
hi.shortDescription: ग्रामीण छात्राओं को 12वीं प्रथम श्रेणी पास करने पर उच्च शिक्षा हेतु ₹500 प्रतिमाह छात्रवृत्ति।

description: ग्रामीण क्षेत्र की बालिकाओं को उच्च शिक्षा प्राप्त करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करने के उद्देश्य से 12वीं कक्षा प्रथम श्रेणी (60% या अधिक) में उत्तीर्ण होने पर कॉलेज में अध्ययन के दौरान ₹500 प्रति माह (₹5,000 प्रति वर्ष) छात्रवृत्ति दी जाती है।
shortDescription: Scholarship of ₹5,000 per academic year for rural girls in MP securing 1st division in Class 12 pursuing higher studies.
benefits: ₹500 per month (up to 10 months = ₹5,000 per year) during graduation
Financial assistance for rural girls to travel to nearby colleges and pursue degrees
eligibility: Girl student residing in a recognized rural area of MP who passed Class 12 in First Division and enrolled in a recognized government/aided college.
documents: Gaon Ki Beti Certificate issued by Gram Panchayat Sarpanch/Secretary
applicationSteps: Obtain Village Domicile certification from Gram Panchayat.
Register on MP State Scholarship Portal (scholarshipportal.mp.nic.in).
Select 'Gaon Ki Beti Yojana' and submit college details.
College verifies enrollment.
Scholarship disbursed directly to student's bank account.
officialDepartment: Higher Education Department, Madhya Pradesh

name: आकांक्षा योजना

hi.name: आकांक्षा योजना
hi.shortDescription: एसटी वर्ग के मेधावी छात्रों को JEE, NEET व AIIMS की निःशुल्क राष्ट्रीय स्तरीय कोचिंग।

description: मध्य प्रदेश के जनजातीय (ST) वर्ग के प्रतिभाशाली विद्यार्थियों को राष्ट्रीय स्तर की प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं (JEE, NEET, AIIMS, CLAT) की तैयारी हेतु प्रतिष्ठित कोचिंग संस्थानों के माध्यम से निःशुल्क आवासीय कोचिंग एवं शिक्षण सामग्री उपलब्ध कराने की योजना।
shortDescription: Free coaching, boarding, and lodging for meritorious Tribal (ST) students preparing for JEE, NEET, and CLAT examinations.
benefits: 100% free coaching in top coaching institutes in Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Gwalior
Free residential hostel accommodation and food allowance
Books and specialized study material kit provided free
eligibility: Student belonging to Scheduled Tribe (ST) of MP who has completed Class 10 with high marks and qualified state entrance screening test.
applicationSteps: Register for Akanksha Entrance Test on tribal.mp.gov.in / mptass portal.
Appear in state screening entrance examination.
Merit-based allotment of coaching centres and accommodation.
Commence fully funded two-year residential coaching.
officialDepartment: Tribal Affairs Department, Govt of Madhya Pradesh

name: महर्षि वाल्मीकि प्रोत्साहन योजना

hi.name: महर्षि वाल्मीकि प्रोत्साहन योजना
hi.shortDescription: वाल्मीकि व अनुसूचित जाति के मेधावी विद्यार्थियों को राष्ट्रीय संस्थानों में प्रवेश पर ₹50,000 प्रोत्साहन।

description: अनुसूचित जाति के विद्यार्थियों द्वारा राष्ट्रीय स्तर की प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं जैसे JEE, NEET, CLAT, NIFT आदि में सफलता प्राप्त कर राष्ट्रीय संस्थानों में प्रवेश लेने पर प्रोत्साहन स्वरूप ₹50,000 की एकमुश्त वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की जाती है।
shortDescription: One-time financial reward of ₹50,000 for SC students securing admission into prestigious national institutes.
benefits: One-time cash incentive of ₹50,000 directly deposited into student account
Boosts confidence and meets initial relocation and laptop expenses
eligibility: Scheduled Caste (SC) student of MP who has secured admission in an IIT, IIM, AIIMS, NIT, NLU, or recognized premier national institute.
documents: Admission Letter and College ID card
applicationSteps: Apply through MPTAAS portal (tribal.mp.gov.in/mptaas).
Submit admission proof and scorecard of premier national institute.
Verification by SC Welfare District Officer.
Incentive of ₹50,000 disbursed via DBT.
officialDepartment: Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Govt of MP

name: मुख्यमंत्री फ्री स्कूटी योजना

hi.name: मुख्यमंत्री फ्री स्कूटी योजना
hi.shortDescription: सरकारी स्कूलों में 12वीं में टॉप करने वाले छात्र-छात्राओं को ई-स्कूटी खरीदने हेतु राशि।

description: मध्य प्रदेश के शासकीय हायर सेकेंडरी स्कूलों में कक्षा 12वीं की बोर्ड परीक्षा में सर्वोच्च अंक (टॉपर) प्राप्त करने वाले छात्र एवं छात्राओं को कॉलेज आने-जाने की सुविधा हेतु निःशुल्क ई-स्कूटी खरीदने के लिए राशि प्रदान की जाती है।
shortDescription: Direct financial aid of up to ₹1,20,000 for purchasing an electric/motorized scooty to top-ranking 12th students of MP Govt schools.
benefits: Grant of up to ₹1,20,000 for electric scooty or ₹90,000 for petrol scooty
One boy and one girl topper from every government higher secondary school benefited
Encourages excellence in secondary school education
eligibility: Regular student of MP Government Higher Secondary School who secured 1st rank (topper among boys and girls) in their school in 12th board exams.
documents: Class 12th Marksheet showing school topper merit
Valid Driving License / Learner License (if applicable)
Quotation / Invoice of Scooty from authorized dealer
applicationSteps: School principal prepares list of merit toppers and forwards to District Education Officer (DEO).
Student registers vehicle quotation on the School Education Portal.
Fund transferred into student account for vehicle procurement.
Submit vehicle registration (RC) copy to DEO office.
officialDepartment: School Education Department, Govt of Madhya Pradesh

name: आयुष्मान भारत - मध्य प्रदेश (निरामयम)

hi.name: आयुष्मान भारत - मध्य प्रदेश
hi.shortDescription: पात्र परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य उपचार।

description: मध्य प्रदेश के गरीब एवं मध्यमवर्गीय परिवारों को गंभीर बीमारियों के इलाज के लिए प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का निःशुल्क कैशलेस इन-पेशेंट उपचार उपलब्ध कराने वाली स्वास्थ्य सुरक्षा योजना।
shortDescription: Cashless health cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year in empanelled hospitals across MP and India.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization up to ₹5 Lakh per annum per family
Over 1,900 surgical and medical procedures covered
Cashless diagnosis, surgery, medicines, and food during hospital stay
Senior citizens aged 70+ receive expanded coverage under recent expansion
eligibility: SECC 2011 identified families, NFSA ration card holders, Sambal card holders, and building construction workers in MP.
incomeLimit: BPL / Ration card / Sambal card holders
applicationSteps: Check name on beneficiary portal beneficiary.nha.gov.in or visit nearest Ayushman Mitra at empanelled hospital / CSC.
Perform biometric Aadhaar e-KYC.
Ayushman Golden Card generated instantly and downloadable.
Show card at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment.
officialDepartment: Public Health & Medical Education Dept, Madhya Pradesh

name: मुख्यमंत्री बाल हृदय उपचार योजना
name_en: Mukhya Mantri Bal Hriday Upchar Yojana

hi.name: मुख्यमंत्री बाल हृदय उपचार योजना
hi.shortDescription: जन्मजात हृदय रोग से पीड़ित बच्चों की निःशुल्क हार्ट सर्जरी व उपचार।

description: जन्मजात हृदय रोग (Congenital Heart Defect) से पीड़ित 0 से 18 वर्ष तक के बच्चों की पहचान कर प्रमुख सुपर-स्पेशियलिटी अस्पतालों में निःशुल्क सर्जरी एवं संपूर्ण इलाज की सुविधा प्रदान करने की योजना।
shortDescription: 100% free surgical treatment for children aged 0 to 18 suffering from congenital heart diseases in premier hospitals.
benefits: Complete free cardiac surgery and post-operative care up to ₹1.5 - ₹2 Lakh per child
Free travel assistance for child and one attendant
Empanelled specialized hospitals (Narayana Hrudayalaya, Medanta, AIIMS, etc.)
eligibility: Resident children of Madhya Pradesh aged 0 to 18 years diagnosed with congenital heart disease.
incomeLimit: Not strict; priority to economically weaker families
documents: MP Domicile of parents & Samagra ID
Cardiology diagnosis report (2D Echo / ECG / Doctor prescription)
Aadhaar Card of Parent and Child
applicationSteps: Get child examined at District Hospital under RBSK (Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram).
Civil Surgeon / CMHO recommends case for heart surgery.
Collectorate approval and referral to empanelled super-speciality hospital.
Hospital performs free surgical intervention.
Follow-up medical checkups funded by state government.
officialDepartment: Public Health and Family Welfare Dept, MP

name: मुख्यमंत्री तीर्थ दर्शन योजना

hi.name: मुख्यमंत्री तीर्थ दर्शन योजना
hi.shortDescription: 60 वर्ष से अधिक के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को देश के प्रमुख तीर्थ स्थलों की निःशुल्क यात्रा।

description: मध्य प्रदेश के 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को देश भर के प्रसिद्ध धार्मिक व तीर्थ स्थलों (काशी, तिरुपति, द्वारका, जगन्नाथ पुरी, अयोध्या आदि) की विशेष ट्रेन एवं हवाई जहाज से निःशुल्क यात्रा कराने की योजना।
shortDescription: Free guided pilgrimage tour by special trains and flights with accommodation and food for senior citizens in MP.
benefits: 100% free train / air travel, food, accommodation, and local transport
Companion permitted for pilgrims above 65 years or with disability
Medical doctor and security escorts accompany every special pilgrim train
eligibility: Permanent resident of MP aged 60+ years (58+ for women). Must be medically fit and non-income tax payer.
documents: MP Domicile certificate and Samagra ID
Medical Fitness Certificate from registered government physician
applicationSteps: Collect application form from Tehsil / Janpad Panchayat / Municipal office.
Attach medical fitness certificate and preferred pilgrimage destination.
Submit application at Tehsil office.
Selection done transparently through computerised lottery by District Collectorate.
Selected pilgrims board designated train / flight on allotted schedule.
officialDepartment: Religious Trusts and Endowments Department, MP

name: सरल बिजली बिल / अटल गृह ज्योति योजना
name_en: Saral Bijli Bill / Atal Griha Jyoti Yojana

hi.name: सरल बिजली बिल / अटल गृह ज्योति योजना
hi.shortDescription: घरेलू उपभोक्ताओं को 100 यूनिट तक बिजली की खपत पर मात्र ₹100 का बिल।

description: मध्य प्रदेश के घरेलू उपभोक्ताओं को राहत प्रदान करने हेतु 100 यूनिट तक मासिक बिजली खपत पर मात्र ₹100 का बिजली बिल देय होता है, जिससे कमजोर और मध्यम वर्गीय परिवारों के बिजली खर्च में भारी कमी आती है।
shortDescription: Electricity tariff subsidy ensuring domestic consumers pay only ₹100 for monthly consumption up to 100 units.
benefits: Monthly bill of ₹100 only for consumption up to 100 units
Subsidized slab up to 150 units consumption
Direct tariff subsidy reimbursed to power distribution companies by state govt
eligibility: Domestic low-tension (LT) electricity consumers in Madhya Pradesh having connected load up to 1 kW.
incomeLimit: Domestic consumer load up to 1 kW
applicationSteps: Subsidy is automatically applied in monthly electricity bills if consumption is under 150 units.
Verify connection load at local DISCOM office (MPPKVVCL / MPMKVVCL / MPPoKVVCL).
Pay reduced bill online via Urja portal or MP Online.
officialDepartment: Energy Department, Govt of Madhya Pradesh

name: प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधि (PM-KISAN)

hi.name: प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधि
hi.shortDescription: सभी भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 की वित्तीय सहायता।

description: भारत सरकार की केंद्रीय क्षेत्र की योजना, जिसके अंतर्गत सभी पात्र भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को कृषि एवं घरेलू आवश्यकताओं की पूर्ति हेतु ₹6,000 प्रति वर्ष तीन समान किस्तों में सीधे उनके बैंक खातों में अंतरित किए जाते हैं।
shortDescription: Direct financial assistance of ₹6,000 per year transferred in three equal four-monthly installments to farmer families.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year transferred in 3 installments of ₹2,000 directly via DBT
Ensures timely funds for procuring agricultural inputs like seeds and fertilizers
Over 11 crore farmers supported nationwide
eligibility: Landholder farmer families having cultivable landholding in their names. Excludes institutional landholders, income tax payees, and constitutional post holders.
documents: Land Ownership Documents (Record of Rights / Khatauni)
applicationSteps: Visit official portal pmkisan.gov.in.
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' under Farmers Corner.
Enter Aadhaar Number, select State, and input land details.
Complete mandatory Aadhaar OTP e-KYC or face-authentication.
State nodal officer verifies records; DBT transferred into bank account.
officialDepartment: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India

name: प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना (PMFBY)

hi.name: प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना
hi.shortDescription: प्राकृतिक आपदाओं से फसल नुकसान पर न्यूनतम प्रीमियम में व्यापक बीमा सुरक्षा।

description: प्राकृतिक आपदाओं, कीटों एवं रोगों के परिणामस्वरूप अधिसूचित फसलों में होने वाले नुकसान की स्थिति में किसानों को व्यापक बीमा आवरण और वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करने वाली राष्ट्रीय योजना।
shortDescription: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against unforeseen natural risks at very low premium rates.
benefits: Nominal premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops
Full insured sum claim without capping
Covers prevented sowing, post-harvest losses, and localized calamities (hailstorm, landslide, inundation)
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
documents: Sowing Certificate issued by Patwari / Gram Pradhan
applicationSteps: Apply through bank branch, CSC, or portal pmfby.gov.in before cut-off date.
Enter farmer details, crop type, survey number, and pay premium share.
Insurance policy receipt generated.
In event of crop damage, report within 72 hours via Crop Insurance App or helpline 14447.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India

name: पीएम कुसुम योजना (PM-KUSUM)
name_en: PM-KUSUM (Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan)

hi.name: पीएम कुसुम योजना
hi.shortDescription: खेतों में सोलर पंप लगाने एवं सौर ऊर्जा संयंत्र स्थापित करने हेतु 60% तक सब्सिडी।

description: किसानों को सिंचाई हेतु सौर ऊर्जा से चलने वाले कृषि पंप लगाने और बंजर भूमि पर सौर संयंत्र स्थापित कर अतिरिक्त बिजली ग्रिड को बेचकर आय बढ़ाने हेतु केंद्र व राज्य सरकारों द्वारा 60% अनुदान की योजना।
shortDescription: Subsidy of up to 60% for installing stand-alone solar agriculture pumps and solarizing grid-connected irrigation pumps.
benefits: 60% total subsidy (30% Central + 30% State Govt), 30% bank loan, farmer pays only 10%
Eliminates dependency on diesel pumps and erratic rural electricity
Farmers can sell surplus solar power to DISCOMs for extra recurring income
eligibility: Individual farmers, Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs), cooperatives, and water user associations with agricultural land.
applicationSteps: Visit state renewable energy development agency portal or pmkusum.mnre.gov.in.
Select desired solar pump capacity (3HP, 5HP, 7.5HP).
Pay farmer beneficiary share through portal.
Authorised vendor installs certified solar pump and tests water discharge.
officialDepartment: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, Govt of India

name: सॉइल हेल्थ कार्ड योजना (Soil Health Card)

hi.name: सॉइल हेल्थ कार्ड योजना
hi.shortDescription: खेत की मिट्टी की जांच और उचित खाद-उर्वरक उपयोग की सटीक सरकारी रिपोर्ट।

description: किसानों को उनकी कृषि भूमि की मिट्टी की गुणवत्ता, पोषक तत्वों की स्थिति एवं आवश्यक उर्वरक मात्रा की सटीक जानकारी उपलब्ध कराने हेतु सॉइल हेल्थ कार्ड जारी किया जाता है, जिससे खेती की लागत कम होती है और पैदावार बढ़ती है।
shortDescription: Biennial soil nutrient testing card recommending customized fertilizer dosages for optimal crop yield.
benefits: Tests 12 vital chemical parameters (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC)
Prevents excessive and expensive chemical fertilizer usage
Improves crop yield and sustains soil fertility
eligibility: All landholding farmers across India.
applicationSteps: Agriculture department staff collects soil sample from field grid.
Sample tested in authorized soil testing laboratory.
Soil Health Card generated and handed over or downloaded online.
Apply fertilizers strictly as per card recommendations.
officialDepartment: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India

name: पीएम प्रणाम योजना (PM PRANAM)
name_en: PM PRANAM (Promotion of Alternate Nutrients for Agriculture Management)

hi.name: पीएम प्रणाम योजना
hi.shortDescription: रासायनिक उर्वरकों के स्थान पर प्राकृतिक एवं जैविक खादों को प्रोत्साहन देने की राष्ट्रीय योजना।

description: रासायनिक उर्वरकों के संतुलित उपयोग को बढ़ावा देने, वैकल्पिक खादों (जैव उर्वरक, नैनो यूरिया) को अपनाने और रासायनिक उर्वरक सब्सिडी में बचत कर राज्यों व किसानों को पुरस्कृत करने की पहल।
shortDescription: Initiative incentivizing states and farmers to adopt alternative and organic fertilizers to protect soil health.
benefits: Subsidies saved on chemical fertilizers transferred to states for rural asset creation
Subsidized nano urea and bio-fertilizer supply
Protection of groundwater and soil microbiology from chemical degradation
eligibility: States, farmer groups, cooperatives, and farmers adopting natural and integrated nutrient management.
applicationSteps: Access training programs through Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVK).
Procure certified bio-fertilizers and nano-inputs through cooperative societies.
Participate in state-level organic cultivation clusters.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers / Dept of Agriculture, Govt of India

name: प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना - ग्रामीण (PMAY-G)

hi.name: प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना - ग्रामीण
hi.shortDescription: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में बेघर व कच्चे मकानों में रहने वाले परिवारों को पक्के घर हेतु ₹1.20 लाख की सहायता।

description: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में कच्चे एवं जीर्ण-शीर्ण घरों में रहने वाले सभी बेघर परिवारों को बुनियादी सुविधाओं से युक्त पक्का मकान बनाने हेतु ₹1,20,000 (मैदानी क्षेत्र) तथा ₹1,30,000 (पहाड़ी/दुर्गम क्षेत्र) की प्रत्यक्ष वित्तीय सहायता उपलब्ध कराने की योजना।
shortDescription: Financial grant of ₹1.20 to ₹1.30 Lakh plus 90-95 days of MGNREGA unskilled labor assistance to construct pucca houses in rural areas.
benefits: Grant of ₹1,20,000 in plains and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult areas
Additional 90-95 days of unskilled employment under MGNREGA (~₹20,000+)
₹12,000 dedicated assistance for toilet construction via Swachh Bharat Mission
LPG connection via PM Ujjwala and electricity via Saubhagya
eligibility: Rural households without a pucca house identified through SECC 2011 and Awaas+ list verified by Gram Sabha.
documents: Land possession document / Gram Panchayat certificate
applicationSteps: Beneficiary list prepared via Awaas+ survey and verified by Gram Sabha.
Geo-tagging of existing site by Panchayat Secretary through AwaasSoft app.
Sanction order issued and first installment released for plinth construction.
Geo-tagging at each construction stage triggers subsequent installment DBT.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Rural Development, Govt of India

name: प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना - शहरी 2.0 (PMAY-U)

hi.name: प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना - शहरी
hi.shortDescription: शहरी मध्यम व निम्न आय वर्ग के परिवारों को पक्का घर खरीदने या बनाने हेतु ₹2.50 लाख तक अनुदान।

description: शहरी क्षेत्रों में रहने वाले आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्ग (EWS), निम्न आय वर्ग (LIG) एवं मध्यम आय वर्ग (MIG) के परिवारों को अपना पहला पक्का घर खरीदने, बनाने या विस्तार करने हेतु ब्याज सब्सिडी और प्रत्यक्ष वित्तीय अनुदान प्रदान करने की योजना।
shortDescription: Government assistance of up to ₹2.5 Lakh including interest subsidies on home loans for urban families building or buying pucca houses.
benefits: Interest subsidy under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) up to ₹2.67 Lakh
Direct grant of ₹1.50 Lakh under Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC)
Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP) with urban local bodies
eligibility: Urban families not owning a pucca house anywhere in India. EWS (Income up to ₹3 Lakh), LIG (Income ₹3-6 Lakh), MIG (Income up to ₹18 Lakh).
documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Land / Property documents or allotment letter
Affidavit affirming non-ownership of pucca house
applicationSteps: Visit pmaymis.gov.in or apply through Citizen Service Centre (CSC).
Choose category: Beneficiary Led Construction or Credit Linked Subsidy.
Enter Aadhaar and municipal ward details.
Verification by Urban Local Body (ULB).
Subsidies credited via direct bank integration or loan account credit.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Govt of India

name: जल जीवन मिशन (Jal Jeevan Mission)

hi.name: जल जीवन मिशन
hi.shortDescription: प्रत्येक ग्रामीण परिवार को नल से शुद्ध व पर्याप्त पीने का पानी पहुंचाने की राष्ट्रीय योजना।

description: भारत के प्रत्येक ग्रामीण परिवार को व्यक्तिगत घरेलू नल कनेक्शन (FHTC) के माध्यम से प्रति व्यक्ति प्रति दिन 55 लीटर गुणवत्तापूर्ण एवं सुरक्षित पेयजल नियमित व दीर्घकालिक आधार पर उपलब्ध कराने की राष्ट्रीय योजना।
shortDescription: Nationwide mission ensuring functional household tap water connections to every rural home.
benefits: Piped potable drinking water connection directly to home tap
Assured 55 liters per capita per day of tested safe drinking water
Relieves rural women and girls from drudgery of fetching water from distant sources
eligibility: Rural households residing in villages across all States and Union Territories of India.
applicationSteps: Village Action Plan formulated by Village Water and Sanitation Committee (VWSC).
Piped water infrastructure laid by Public Health Engineering Department.
Household tap connection installed and verified on JJM dashboard.
Report grievances on Jal Jeevan Samvad portal.
officialDepartment: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti

name: स्वच्छ भारत मिशन (Swachh Bharat Mission 2.0)

hi.name: स्वच्छ भारत मिशन
hi.shortDescription: खुले में शौच मुक्ति, ठोस-तरल कचरा प्रबंधन एवं व्यक्तिगत शौचालय निर्माण हेतु ₹12,000 अनुदान।

description: संपूर्ण भारत को खुले में शौच से मुक्त (ODF Plus) बनाए रखने, प्रत्येक छूटे हुए परिवार को व्यक्तिगत घरेलू शौचालय (IHHL) निर्माण हेतु ₹12,000 की वित्तीय सहायता तथा ग्रामों व शहरों में वैज्ञानिक कचरा प्रबंधन लागू करने की योजना।
shortDescription: Incentive of ₹12,000 for individual household toilet construction and comprehensive waste management.
benefits: Incentive of ₹12,000 for constructing individual sanitary toilet
Promotion of public health, hygiene, and dignity for women
Solid and Liquid Waste Management (SLWM) in every gram panchayat
eligibility: Rural and urban households not having an individual sanitary toilet. Covers SC/ST, small/marginal farmers, women-headed households, and BPL families.
documents: Photograph of applicant with toilet under construction
applicationSteps: Apply online on sbm.gov.in or through Gram Panchayat Secretary / Ward Officer.
Submit Aadhaar and bank details for IHHL registration.
Construct sanitary latrine as per specified twin-pit technical design.
Geo-tagging and verification of completed toilet.
Incentive of ₹12,000 deposited directly into bank account.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Jal Shakti / Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs

name: पीएम सूर्य घर: मुफ्त बिजली योजना (PM Surya Ghar)
name_en: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana

hi.name: पीएम सूर्य घर योजना
hi.shortDescription: घरों की छत पर सोलर पैनल लगाने हेतु ₹78,000 तक सब्सिडी व 300 यूनिट मुफ्त बिजली।

description: भारत के एक करोड़ घरों की छतों पर रूफटॉप सोलर सिस्टम स्थापित कर परिवारों को प्रति माह 300 यूनिट तक निःशुल्क सौर बिजली उपलब्ध कराने तथा ₹78,000 तक की प्रत्यक्ष केंद्रीय वित्तीय सब्सिडी देने की महा-योजना।
shortDescription: Direct capital subsidy up to ₹78,000 for installing residential rooftop solar panels ensuring up to 300 units of free electricity every month.
benefits: Subsidy of ₹30,000 for 1 kW system
Subsidy of ₹60,000 for 2 kW system
Subsidy of ₹78,000 for 3 kW and higher systems
Up to 300 units free solar electricity every month, saving ₹15,000+ per year in power bills
Collateral-free low-interest bank loans at ~7% interest available via Jan Samarth portal
eligibility: Indian citizen household with a suitable roof with clear sunshine and an active residential electricity connection in their name.
documents: Proof of roof ownership / tenancy authorization
applicationSteps: Register on national portal pmsuryaghar.gov.in with Consumer Account Number and DISCOM name.
Apply for rooftop solar net-metering feasibility approval.
Choose registered empaneled vendor and install system.
Net-meter installed and commissioning certificate generated by DISCOM.
Subsidy transferred directly into bank account within 30 days.
officialDepartment: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, Govt of India

name: पीएम स्वनिधि योजना (PM SVANidhi)

hi.name: पीएम स्वनिधि योजना
hi.shortDescription: स्ट्रीट वेंडरों को ₹10,000 से ₹50,000 तक बिना गारंटी कार्यशील पूंजी ऋण व 7% ब्याज सब्सिडी।

description: शहरी एवं उप-शहरी क्षेत्रों में रेहड़ी-पटरी, ठेला एवं फुटपाथ पर दुकान लगाने वाले स्ट्रीट वेंडरों को अपने व्यवसाय को पुनः गति देने हेतु बिना किसी गारंटी के ₹10,000, ₹20,000 और ₹50,000 का रियायती कार्यशील पूंजी ऋण प्रदान करने की योजना।
shortDescription: Collateral-free working capital micro-loans of ₹10K, ₹20K, and ₹50K with 7% interest subsidy and cashback on digital transactions.
benefits: 1st tranche: ₹10,000 loan; on timely repayment 2nd tranche: ₹20,000; 3rd tranche: ₹50,000
7% annual interest subsidy credited directly into bank account
Monthly digital cashback reward of up to ₹100 for digital payments
No collateral or third-party guarantee required
eligibility: Street vendors vending in urban areas possessing Certificate of Vending / ID card issued by Urban Local Body or recommendation letter (LoR).
documents: Vending Certificate / Urban Local Body ID Card / Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
applicationSteps: Visit pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
Enter mobile number and Aadhaar for OTP verification.
Select lending bank or microfinance institution.
Urban local body validates vending credentials.
Loan disbursed directly into vendor's bank account.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Govt of India

name: प्रधानमंत्री ग्राम सड़क योजना (PMGSY)

hi.name: प्रधानमंत्री ग्राम सड़क योजना
hi.shortDescription: ग्रामीण बस्तियों को हर मौसम में चालू रहने वाली पक्की सड़कों से जोड़ने की योजना।

description: देश के असंबद्ध ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों एवं बस्तियों को बारहमासी (ऑल-वेदर) पक्की सड़कों के माध्यम से मुख्य सड़क नेटवर्क से जोड़ने की राष्ट्रव्यापी बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजना।
shortDescription: Nationwide infrastructure scheme connecting unconnected habitations with all-weather motorable roads.
benefits: All-weather macadamized road connectivity to rural habitations
Drastic reduction in travel time to health centres, schools, and markets
Boosts rural commerce and agricultural logistics
eligibility: Rural habitations having population of 500+ (plains) or 250+ (hilly/tribal/desert regions) without all-weather road connectivity.
documents: Habitation connectivity proposal by Gram Sabha / Panchayat
applicationSteps: District Rural Road Plan approved by District Panchayat and State Nodal Agency.
Technical approval by National Rural Infrastructure Development Agency (NRIDA).
Competitive e-tendering and construction.
Citizens can monitor progress on OMMAS portal and Meri Sadak app.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Rural Development, Govt of India

name: स्मार्ट सिटी मिशन (Smart Cities Mission)

hi.name: स्मार्ट सिटी मिशन
hi.shortDescription: 100 भारतीय शहरों में आधुनिक नागरिक सुविधाएं, डिजिटल तकनीक व सतत बुनियादी ढांचा।

description: देश के 100 चयनित शहरों में कोर इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर, स्वच्छ व टिकाऊ पर्यावरण, डिजिटल गवर्नेंस और नागरिकों को गुणवत्तापूर्ण जीवन प्रदान करने हेतु एकीकृत कमान एवं नियंत्रण केंद्र (ICCC) व स्मार्ट गतिशीलता विकसित करने की योजना।
shortDescription: Urban transformation mission upgrading core infrastructure, digital transit, smart surveillance, and citizen services in 100 cities.
benefits: Smart traffic management and Integrated Command and Control Centres (ICCC)
High quality public spaces, non-motorized transport, and smart water management
Improved municipal service delivery through mobile apps and citizen portals
eligibility: Citizens residing in 100 designated Smart Cities across India.
applicationSteps: Access city municipal services via respective Smart City citizen portal / mobile app.
Participate in citizen consultation surveys on Smartnet portal.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Govt of India

name: प्रधानमंत्री जन धन योजना (PMJDY)

hi.name: प्रधानमंत्री जन धन योजना
hi.shortDescription: प्रत्येक अनबैंक परिवार के लिए जीरो बैलेंस खाता, रुपे कार्ड व ₹2 लाख का दुर्घटना बीमा।

description: देश के प्रत्येक नागरिक को बैंकिंग सेवाओं (बचत खाता, प्रेषण, ऋण, बीमा, पेंशन) से जोड़ने हेतु शून्य न्यूनतम बैलेंस बचत बैंक खाता, मुफ्त RuPay डेबिट कार्ड और ₹2 लाख तक का दुर्घटना बीमा कवर प्रदान करने वाली राष्ट्रीय योजना।
shortDescription: National financial inclusion mission providing zero-balance bank accounts, RuPay debit card, and ₹2 Lakh accidental insurance cover.
benefits: Zero minimum balance required in bank account
Free RuPay Debit Card with ₹2,00,000 built-in accidental insurance cover
Overdraft (OD) facility up to ₹10,000 for eligible account holders
Direct recipient of all government DBT subsidies and benefits
eligibility: Any Indian citizen aged 10 years and above who does not possess a basic savings bank deposit account.
documents: Aadhaar Card (or Voter ID / Driving License / NREGA Card)
applicationSteps: Visit any bank branch or Bank Mitra / Business Correspondent (BC) kiosk.
Fill PMJDY account opening form.
Submit Aadhaar card copy with biometric verification.
Account opened instantly and RuPay Debit Card issued.
officialDepartment: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India

name: प्रधानमंत्री मुद्रा योजना (PMMY)

hi.name: प्रधानमंत्री मुद्रा योजना
hi.shortDescription: छोटे उद्यमियों व व्यवसायियों को ₹20 लाख तक का बिना गारंटी का व्यावसायिक ऋण।

description: गैर-कॉर्पोरेट, गैर-कृषि लघु एवं सूक्ष्म उद्यमों को विनिर्माण, प्रसंस्करण, व्यापार या सेवा गतिविधियों हेतु ₹20 लाख तक का संपार्श्विक-मुक्त (बिना गारंटी) ऋण बैंकों एवं वित्तीय संस्थानों द्वारा उपलब्ध कराने की योजना।
shortDescription: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹20 Lakh categorized into Shishu (up to ₹50K), Kishore (₹50K-₹5L), and Tarun (₹5L-₹20L).
benefits: Shishu: Loans up to ₹50,000 for early stage micro-enterprises
Kishor: Loans from ₹50,000 up to ₹5,00,000 for developing units
Tarun & Tarun Plus: Loans from ₹5,00,000 up to ₹20,00,000 for scaling businesses
No collateral or third party guarantee required; reasonable interest rates
eligibility: Any Indian citizen having a feasible business idea or existing micro-enterprise in manufacturing, trading, or service sector.
documents: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID
Business address proof & quotation of machinery/inventory
applicationSteps: Apply online on Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or visit any commercial / gramin bank.
Select loan tier (Shishu, Kishor, or Tarun) and upload business plan.
Bank appraises project viability.
Loan sanctioned and Mudra card issued for working capital withdrawals.
officialDepartment: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India

name: स्टैंड-अप इंडिया योजना (Stand-Up India)

hi.name: स्टैंड-अप इंडिया योजना
hi.shortDescription: महिला, एससी व एसटी उद्यमियों को ग्रीनफील्ड उद्यम हेतु ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक बैंक ऋण।

description: अनुसूचित जाति (SC), अनुसूचित जनजाति (ST) एवं महिला उद्यमियों द्वारा विनिर्माण, सेवा, व्यापार अथवा कृषि-संबंधित गतिविधियों में पहला नया (ग्रीनफील्ड) उद्यम स्थापित करने हेतु ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक बैंक ऋण उपलब्ध कराने की योजना।
shortDescription: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC/ST and one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.
benefits: Composite loan (term loan + working capital) between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore
Margin money requirement lowered up to 15%
Credit guarantee cover through NCGTC
Mentorship and handholding support through SIDBI
eligibility: SC / ST individuals and Women entrepreneurs aged 18+ setting up a new enterprise (first-time venture). In non-individual enterprises, 51% shareholding must be held by SC/ST or woman.
documents: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Proof of SC/ST status (if applicable)
Premises lease agreement or ownership documents
applicationSteps: Register on standupmitra.in portal.
Access handholding support and select target bank branch.
Upload project proposal and documentation.
Bank evaluates proposal and sanctions loan under Stand-Up India guidelines.
officialDepartment: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India

name: सुकन्या समृद्धि योजना (SSY)

hi.name: सुकन्या समृद्धि योजना
hi.shortDescription: 10 वर्ष से कम आयु की बालिकाओं के लिए उच्च ब्याज दर (8.2%) व टैक्स-फ्री बचत खाता।

description: 'बेटी बचाओ बेटी पढ़ाओ' अभियान के अंतर्गत बालिकाओं की उच्च शिक्षा एवं विवाह खर्चों की पूर्ति हेतु माता-पिता द्वारा खोला जाने वाला आकर्षक ब्याज दर (8.2% वार्षिक) और पूर्णतः कर-मुक्त (EEE स्टेटस) लघु बचत खाता।
shortDescription: Government small-savings scheme for girl children below 10 years offering 8.2% annual interest and Section 80C tax exemption.
benefits: High sovereign guaranteed interest rate (currently 8.2% compounded annually)
Tax exemption under Section 80C on deposit, interest, and maturity (Triple EEE status)
Minimum deposit of only ₹250 per year (maximum ₹1.5 Lakh)
Partial withdrawal of up to 50% allowed for girl's higher education after age 18
eligibility: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child resident in India. Account can be opened before girl child attains 10 years of age. Maximum 2 girls per family.
documents: Aadhaar Card and PAN of parent/guardian
Passport photographs of child and guardian
applicationSteps: Visit any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch.
Fill Sukanya Samriddhi Account opening form.
Submit child birth certificate and parent KYC documents with initial deposit (min ₹250).
Passbook issued; maintain deposits online or offline until 15 years from account opening.
officialDepartment: Department of Posts / Ministry of Finance, Govt of India

name: अटल पेंशन योजना (APY)

hi.name: अटल पेंशन योजना
hi.shortDescription: 18 से 40 वर्ष के नागरिकों के लिए ₹1,000 से ₹5,000 प्रतिमाह की आजीवन गारंटीड सरकारी पेंशन।

description: असंगठित क्षेत्र के कामगारों और नागरिकों को वृद्धावस्था में सामाजिक सुरक्षा प्रदान करने हेतु 60 वर्ष की आयु पूर्ण होने पर ₹1,000 से ₹5,000 प्रतिमाह की न्यूनतम निश्चित आजीवन पेंशन उपलब्ध कराने वाली राष्ट्रीय पेंशन योजना।
shortDescription: Government-backed guaranteed lifelong pension ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month starting after age 60.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000 or ₹5,000 per month after 60 years
Lifelong pension to subscriber, and after subscriber's demise to the spouse
Return of full accumulated pension corpus to nominee after demise of spouse
Nominal monthly contributions auto-debited from savings account
eligibility: Indian citizens aged between 18 and 40 years holding a savings bank account. Must not be an income-tax payer.
documents: Savings Bank Account / Post Office Account
applicationSteps: Visit your bank branch or log in to net banking / mobile banking app.
Select 'Atal Pension Yojana' registration.
Choose desired pension amount (₹1,000 to ₹5,000) and nomination details.
Auto-debit mandate setup from bank account.
Download PRAN and APY subscriber e-card.
officialDepartment: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)

name: एनपीएस वात्सल्य योजना (NPS Vatsalya)

hi.name: एनपीएस वात्सल्य योजना
hi.shortDescription: नाबालिग बच्चों के भविष्य हेतु पेंशन खाता, जो 18 वर्ष का होने पर नियमित एनपीएस में परिवर्तित होगा।

description: माता-पिता द्वारा अपने नाबालिग बच्चों (18 वर्ष से कम) के नाम से दीर्घकालिक वित्तीय सुरक्षा एवं पेंशन कोष तैयार करने हेतु शुरू की गई राष्ट्रीय योजना। 18 वर्ष की आयु पूरी होने पर यह खाता निर्बाध रूप से सामान्य NPS टियर-1 खाते में परिवर्तित हो जाता है।
shortDescription: Contributory pension savings scheme for minors operated by parents with minimum ₹1,000 annual contribution.
benefits: Flexible contributions starting from just ₹1,000 annually
Compound growth via diversified market investments (Equities, Corporate Debt, Govt Securities)
Seamless auto-conversion to standard NPS account upon minor turning 18
Disciplined wealth creation for long-term retirement security
eligibility: All minor Indian citizens (aged below 18 years) through their parents or legal guardians.
documents: Guardian's PAN Card and Aadhaar Card
applicationSteps: Visit eNPS portal or authorized Point of Presence (POP) bank branch.
Select NPS Vatsalya Account Registration.
Complete guardian KYC and submit child's birth certificate.
Make initial deposit (min ₹1,000) and receive PRAN allotment.
officialDepartment: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)

name: बेटी बचाओ बेटी पढ़ाओ (BBBP)

hi.name: बेटी बचाओ बेटी पढ़ाओ
hi.shortDescription: बाल लिंगानुपात में सुधार, कन्या भ्रूण हत्या रोकथाम व बालिकाओं की शिक्षा सुनिश्चित करने का राष्ट्रीय अभियान।

description: गिरते बाल लिंगानुपात (CSR) को रोकने, कन्या भ्रूण हत्या पर प्रभावी प्रतिबंध लगाने, बालिकाओं के अस्तित्व, संरक्षण तथा अनिवार्य माध्यमिक व उच्चतर शिक्षा को बढ़ावा देने वाला प्रमुख राष्ट्रीय बहु-क्षेत्रीय अभियान।
shortDescription: National initiative ensuring protection, survival, nutrition, and secondary education for the girl child across India.
benefits: District level convergence ensuring zero dropouts for girls in secondary schools
Special scholarship programs and residential hostel facilities (KGBV)
Strict enforcement of PC&PNDT Act to eliminate gender-biased sex selection
Awareness camps and community rewards for girl child excellence
eligibility: All girl children across all districts of India.
applicationSteps: Community advocacy campaign implemented via Anganwadi Centers and Government Schools.
Enrol girl child in nearby school and link with Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana.
Access institutional delivery benefits and school health checkups.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Govt of India

name: प्रधानमंत्री मातृ वंदना योजना (PMMVY 2.0)

hi.name: प्रधानमंत्री मातृ वंदना योजना
hi.shortDescription: गर्भवती व स्तनपान कराने वाली माताओं को पोषण व मजदूरी क्षतिपूर्ति हेतु ₹5,000 से ₹6,000 की सहायता।

description: गर्भवती महिलाओं और स्तनपान कराने वाली माताओं को पहले जीवित बच्चे के जन्म पर ₹5,000 तथा दूसरे बच्चे के रूप में कन्या जन्म पर ₹6,000 की प्रत्यक्ष नकद प्रोत्साहन सहायता प्रदान करने वाली योजना, जिससे पोषण में सुधार और मजदूरी क्षतिपूर्ति होती है।
shortDescription: Direct cash incentive of ₹5,000 for first child and ₹6,000 for second girl child to pregnant women and lactating mothers.
benefits: First child: ₹5,000 in two installments upon antenatal check-up (ANC) and child birth vaccination
Second child (if girl child): ₹6,000 in a single installment post vaccination
Promotes institutional delivery and full immunization of infants
Direct DBT transfer into Aadhaar-seeded bank account
eligibility: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM) who are not regular employees of Central/State Government or PSUs. Family income below ₹8 Lakh or holder of BPL/e-Shram/MGNREGA card.
documents: Aadhaar Card of mother and husband
Aadhaar-linked Bank Account details of mother
applicationSteps: Register at nearest Anganwadi Center or online on pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.
Submit MCP card details with proof of early ANC check-up.
Anganwadi Worker / ASHA validates registration.
Installments disbursed directly into beneficiary's bank account via DBT.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Govt of India

name: पोषण अभियान (POSHAN Abhiyaan 2.0)

hi.name: पोषण अभियान
hi.shortDescription: बच्चों, किशोरियों एवं गर्भवती महिलाओं में कुपोषण और एनीमिया दूर करने का राष्ट्रीय मिशन।

description: 0 से 6 वर्ष तक के छोटे बच्चों, किशोरियों, गर्भवती महिलाओं और स्तनपान कराने वाली माताओं के पोषण स्तर में सुधार लाने, बौनापन (स्टंटिंग), कुपोषण (वेस्टिंग) तथा एनीमिया के स्तर में तीव्र कमी लाने का समग्र राष्ट्रीय अभियान।
shortDescription: Multi-sectoral national mission curbing malnutrition, stunting, wasting, and anemia among children and mothers.
benefits: Supplementary Nutrition Programme (SNP) hot cooked meals and take-home rations (THR)
Growth monitoring and health tracking using Poshan Tracker mobile app
Early childhood care, micronutrient supplementation, and deworming
eligibility: Children under 6 years, adolescent girls (14-18 years in aspirational districts), and pregnant/lactating women.
applicationSteps: Enroll at local Anganwadi Center.
Anganwadi Worker registers child/mother on Poshan Tracker.
Receive regular nutrition supplements, medical checkups, and growth monitoring.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Govt of India

name: प्रधानमंत्री उज्ज्वला योजना (PMUY 2.0)

hi.name: प्रधानमंत्री उज्ज्वला योजना
hi.shortDescription: गरीब ग्रामीण महिलाओं को निःशुल्क एलपीजी गैस कनेक्शन, पहला सिलेंडर व चूल्हा।

description: गरीब परिवारों की वयस्क महिलाओं को धुएं से मुक्ति दिलाने और स्वच्छ रसोई ईंधन प्रदान करने हेतु निःशुल्क एलपीजी कनेक्शन, सुरक्षा नली, गैस चूल्हा (हॉटप्लेट) तथा पहला सिलेंडर 100% निःशुल्क उपलब्ध कराने की योजना।
shortDescription: Free deposit-free LPG gas connection with first refill and stove provided to adult women from low-income families.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG cylinder connection
First domestic LPG refill provided free of cost
Free hotplate (stove) along with connection
Ongoing targeted subsidy of ₹300 per cylinder for up to 12 refills per year
eligibility: Adult woman (aged 18+) belonging to poor household (SECC list, BPL, SC/ST, PMAY beneficiary, Forest dwellers, Most Backward Classes) without existing LPG connection.
applicationSteps: Apply online on pmuy.gov.in or submit form at nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas).
Submit Aadhaar, Ration Card and bank passbook.
Distributor performs de-duplication check.
Connection issued with stove and filled cylinder delivered to doorstep.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Govt of India

name: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (PM-JAY)

hi.name: आयुष्मान भारत PM-JAY
hi.shortDescription: देश के 12 करोड़ गरीब परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख का कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य उपचार।

description: विश्व की सबसे बड़ी सरकार द्वारा वित्तपोषित स्वास्थ्य आश्वासन योजना, जिसके अंतर्गत देश के 55 करोड़ से अधिक पात्र नागरिकों एवं 70 वर्ष से अधिक आयु के सभी वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस इनपेशेंट अस्पताल उपचार प्रदान किया जाता है।
shortDescription: World's largest government health assurance scheme covering cashless hospital care up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year.
benefits: Cashless and paperless access to services at empanelled public and private hospitals across India
Up to ₹5,00,000 cover per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization
Covers pre-existing conditions from day one, covering 1,949 medical procedures
Universal coverage for all senior citizens aged 70 and above regardless of income
eligibility: Families identified in SECC 2011 deprivation criteria, NFSA ration card holders, and all Indian citizens aged 70 years and above.
documents: Ration Card / PM Letter / Family ID
applicationSteps: Check eligibility on beneficiary.nha.gov.in.
Complete Aadhaar e-KYC using facial recognition or OTP.
Download Ayushman Card (Golden Card) instantly on smartphone.
Present Ayushman Card at helpdesk of any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment.
officialDepartment: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare

name: आयुष्मान भारत डिजिटल मिशन (ABDM)

hi.name: आयुष्मान भारत डिजिटल मिशन
hi.shortDescription: 14 अंकों का डिजिटल स्वास्थ्य खाता (ABHA ID), मेडिकल रिकॉर्ड्स का सुरक्षित ऑनलाइन संग्रह।

description: भारत के प्रत्येक नागरिक के लिए 14 अंकों की विशिष्ट आभा (ABHA) हेल्थ आईडी बनाकर सभी मेडिकल रिकॉर्ड्स, पर्चियां, लैब रिपोर्ट और डिस्चार्ज समरी को डिजिटल रूप से सुरक्षित रखने एवं डॉक्टरों के साथ सहमति-आधारित साझा करने का राष्ट्रीय डिजिटल स्वास्थ्य तंत्र।
shortDescription: Creation of 14-digit Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) ID for seamless, consent-based digital sharing of personal medical records.
benefits: 14-digit unique ABHA health identification number for life
Store prescriptions, lab tests, scans, and diagnostic reports digitally in one place
Skip long OPD queues using 'Scan and Share' QR codes at hospitals
Complete data privacy with patient consent-driven record sharing
eligibility: All Indian citizens.
applicationSteps: Visit abha.abdm.gov.in or download ABHA App.
Enter 12-digit Aadhaar number and enter OTP received on mobile.
Create your customized ABHA address (e.g., name@abdm).
Download ABHA Card with digital QR code.
officialDepartment: National Health Authority (NHA), Govt of India

name: प्रधानमंत्री सुरक्षा बीमा योजना (PMSBY)

hi.name: प्रधानमंत्री सुरक्षा बीमा योजना
hi.shortDescription: मात्र ₹20 प्रति वर्ष में ₹2 लाख का दुर्घटना मृत्यु एवं दिव्यांगता बीमा कवर।

description: 18 से 70 वर्ष के नागरिकों को आकस्मिक मृत्यु अथवा पूर्ण स्थायी दिव्यांगता की स्थिति में ₹2,00,000 तथा आंशिक स्थायी दिव्यांगता पर ₹1,00,000 का दुर्घटना बीमा कवर मात्र ₹20 वार्षिक प्रीमियम पर उपलब्ध कराने की योजना।
shortDescription: Accidental death and disability insurance cover of ₹2 Lakh at an ultra-low premium of just ₹20 per year.
benefits: ₹2,00,000 insurance payout on accidental death or permanent total disability
₹1,00,000 payout on permanent partial disability
Nominal annual premium of ₹20 auto-debited once a year in May
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 to 70 years holding an active savings bank account or post office account.
documents: Savings Bank Account details with auto-debit consent
applicationSteps: Log in to internet banking / mobile banking or visit home bank branch.
Opt-in for PMSBY insurance scheme.
Authorize annual auto-debit of ₹20 from savings account.
Insurance certificate / policy number generated.
officialDepartment: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India

name: प्रधानमंत्री जीवन ज्योति बीमा योजना (PMJJBY)
name_en: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana

hi.name: प्रधानमंत्री जीवन ज्योति बीमा योजना
hi.shortDescription: ₹436 प्रति वर्ष के प्रीमियम पर किसी भी कारण से मृत्यु होने पर ₹2 लाख का जीवन बीमा।

description: 18 से 50 वर्ष के बैंक खाताधारकों को किसी भी कारणवश (प्राकृतिक अथवा दुर्घटना) मृत्यु होने पर उनके परिवार/नामिती को ₹2,00,000 का एकमुश्त जीवन बीमा दावा प्रदान करने वाली किफायती सामाजिक सुरक्षा योजना।
shortDescription: Renewable term life insurance cover of ₹2 Lakh for death due to any reason at ₹436 per year.
benefits: ₹2,00,000 life insurance coverage payable to nominee upon death of subscriber
Covers death due to any cause (illness, natural, or accidental)
Simple auto-debit premium of ₹436 per annum directly from bank account
eligibility: Individuals aged 18 to 50 years having a savings bank account with consent to join auto-debit.
applicationSteps: Subscribe through bank net-banking or visit branch / BC kiosk.
Fill consent-cum-declaration form with nominee particulars.
Annual premium of ₹436 debited.
Acknowledgement slip with policy details issued.
officialDepartment: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India

name: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम (MGNREGA)
name_en: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act

hi.name: मनरेगा योजना
hi.shortDescription: ग्रामीण परिवारों को प्रति वित्तीय वर्ष कम से कम 100 दिन के अकुशल रोजगार की कानूनी गारंटी।

description: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में प्रत्येक परिवार जिसके वयस्क सदस्य अकुशल शारीरिक श्रम करने के इच्छुक हैं, उन्हें एक वित्तीय वर्ष में कम से कम 100 दिनों के सवैतनिक रोजगार की वैधानिक गारंटी प्रदान करने वाला ऐतिहासिक अधिनियम।
shortDescription: Statutory legal guarantee of 100 days of wage employment per financial year to adult members of rural households.
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of unskilled wage employment per household per year
Statutory minimum wage paid directly to bank account within 15 days
Unemployment allowance payable if work is not allocated within 15 days of demand
Creche, drinking water, and first aid facilities provided at worksites
eligibility: Adult members (18+ years) of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work.
documents: Photograph of all adult family members
Proof of residence in Gram Panchayat
applicationSteps: Submit application to Gram Panchayat Secretary for Job Card.
Job Card issued within 15 days of application.
Submit written work application demanding employment.
Work allocated within 5 km of village; wages paid weekly/fortnightly via ABPS.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Rural Development, Govt of India

name: प्रधानमंत्री कौशल विकास योजना (PMKVY 4.0)

hi.name: प्रधानमंत्री कौशल विकास योजना
hi.shortDescription: युवाओं को निःशुल्क उद्योग-प्रासंगिक कौशल प्रशिक्षण, सरकारी प्रमाण पत्र व रोजगार सहायता।

description: देश के युवाओं को उद्योग-उन्मुख कौशल (कोडिंग, रोबोटिक्स, 3डी प्रिंटिंग, ड्रोन, एआई, हेल्थकेयर, ऑटोमोटिव) में निःशुल्क अल्पकालिक प्रशिक्षण, राष्ट्रीय स्तर का कौशल प्रमाण पत्र और रोजगार/स्वरोजगार के अवसर प्रदान करने की योजना।
shortDescription: Industry-relevant short-term vocational training, NSQF certification, and placement assistance for Indian youth.
benefits: 100% free training courses aligned with National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF)
Covers cutting-edge Industry 4.0 skills (AI, IoT, Drones, Robotics, Mechatronics)
Govt of India skill certificate and monetary reward upon certification
Rozgar Melas and apprenticeship linkages
eligibility: Indian youth aged 15 to 45 years who are school/college dropouts or unemployed seeking industry skills.
applicationSteps: Register on Skill India Digital portal skillindiadigital.gov.in.
Browse accredited training centres and courses by location/job role.
Enroll in preferred training batch.
Complete classroom and practical training.
Pass third-party assessment and obtain NSQF certificate.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Govt of India

name: पीएम विश्वकर्मा योजना (PM Vishwakarma)

hi.name: पीएम विश्वकर्मा योजना
hi.shortDescription: 18 पारंपरिक कारीगरों व शिल्पकारों को ₹3 लाख तक का 5% पर ऋण, टूलकिट हेतु ₹15,000 व प्रशिक्षण।

description: हाथों और औजारों से काम करने वाले 18 पारंपरिक शिल्पों के कारीगरों (बढ़ई, लोहार, कुम्हार, मूर्तिकार, मोची, दर्जी, धोबी आदि) को पहचान, कौशल उन्नयन, ₹15,000 की टूलकिट प्रोत्साहन राशि तथा 5% की रियायती ब्याज दर पर ₹3 लाख तक संपार्श्विक-मुक्त ऋण प्रदान करने की योजना।
shortDescription: End-to-end support for traditional artisans including ₹15K modern toolkit grant, daily ₹500 stipend during training, and collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹3 Lakh at 5% interest.
benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card recognition
5-7 days basic skill training with ₹500 per day stipend
₹15,000 e-voucher grant for purchasing modern professional toolkit
Collateral-free enterprise loan: 1st tranche up to ₹1,00,000 (18 months); 2nd tranche up to ₹2,00,000 (30 months) at 5% interest
Incentive for digital transactions (₹1 per transaction up to 100/month) and marketing support
eligibility: Artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in one of 18 family-based traditional trades aged 18+. One member per family eligible.
socialCategory: All (OBC, SC, ST and General artisans)
applicationSteps: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and mobile.
Register on pmvishwakarma.gov.in in your trade.
Three-tier verification: Gram Panchayat / ULB, District Committee, and State Screening.
Attend basic training and receive PM Vishwakarma ID and toolkit incentive.
Apply for concessional loan through the portal.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME), Govt of India

name: स्टार्टअप इंडिया (Startup India)

hi.name: स्टार्टअप इंडिया
hi.shortDescription: इनोवेटिव स्टार्टअप्स हेतु 3 वर्ष टैक्स छूट, सीड फंड, पेटेंट में 80% छूट व आसान फंडिंग।

description: भारत में नवाचार और स्टार्टअप संस्कृति को बढ़ावा देने, युवाओं को रोजगार सृजक बनाने, डीपीआईआईटी मान्यता प्राप्त स्टार्टअप्स को 3 वर्षों के लिए आयकर छूट, आसान सार्वजनिक खरीद तथा ₹50 लाख तक का स्टार्टअप सीड फंड (SISFS) उपलब्ध कराने की राष्ट्रीय पहल।
shortDescription: Flagship initiative offering DPIIT recognition, 3-year income tax holiday (Section 80-IAC), 80% patent rebate, and up to ₹50 Lakh seed funding.
benefits: DPIIT Certificate of Recognition for 10 years from incorporation
100% income tax exemption for 3 consecutive years out of 10 years
Up to ₹20 Lakh grant for proof of concept and up to ₹50 Lakh debt for commercialization under SISFS
80% rebate in patent filing fees and 50% rebate in trademark filing
Exemption from prior turnover and experience criteria in Government e-Marketplace (GeM)
eligibility: Private Limited Company, LLP, or Registered Partnership incorporated not more than 10 years ago with annual turnover under ₹100 Crore working towards innovation/improvement.
documents: Certificate of Incorporation / Registration of entity
Pitch Deck / Brief write-up on innovation and scalability
Website or mobile app link (if available)
applicationSteps: Register on startupindia.gov.in portal.
Apply for DPIIT Recognition online by providing company details and innovation pitch.
Receive DPIIT Recognition Certificate within 2-3 working days.
Apply for Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS) through shortlisted incubators.
officialDepartment: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Govt of India

name: मेक इन इंडिया (Make in India)

hi.name: मेक इन इंडिया
hi.shortDescription: घरेलू विनिर्माण को बढ़ावा, प्रत्यक्ष विदेशी निवेश (FDI) सुगमता व पीएलआई प्रोत्साहन योजनाएं।

description: भारत को वैश्विक डिजाइन और विनिर्माण केंद्र में परिवर्तित करने, 27 प्रमुख क्षेत्रों में प्रोडक्शन लिंक्ड इंसेंटिव (PLI) योजनाओं के माध्यम से घरेलू विनिर्माण को बढ़ावा देने तथा व्यापार सुगमता (Ease of Doing Business) सुनिश्चित करने की राष्ट्रीय पहल।
shortDescription: National manufacturing initiative driving domestic manufacturing across 27 sectors with ₹1.97 Lakh Crore PLI schemes.
benefits: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes providing 4% to 6% incremental output subsidies
Single Window Clearance System (National Single Window System - NSWS)
Fast-track industrial land allocation and customs duty rationalization
eligibility: Manufacturing companies, MSMEs, industrial investors, and technology enterprises registered in India.
applicationSteps: Access National Single Window System (nsws.gov.in).
Identify applicable PLI scheme or manufacturing clearance clearances.
Submit unified application form.
Track approvals and submit production proof for PLI disbursements.
officialDepartment: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Govt of India

name: डिजिटल इंडिया (Digital India Programme)

hi.name: डिजिटल इंडिया कार्यक्रम
hi.shortDescription: डिजिटल इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर, ऑनलाइन सरकारी सेवाएं (DigiLocker, UMANG) व डिजिटल साक्षरता।

description: भारत को डिजिटल रूप से सशक्त समाज और ज्ञान अर्थव्यवस्था में बदलने, प्रत्येक नागरिक को हाई-स्पीड इंटरनेट, डिजिलॉकर, उमंग, यूपीआई तथा ऑनलाइन प्रमाण पत्र व सेवाएं उपलब्ध कराने का महा-कार्यक्रम।
shortDescription: Comprehensive digital transformation initiative offering citizen e-services (DigiLocker, UMANG, e-Sign, Bhashini, BharatNet).
benefits: Access to 1,000+ government services on single UMANG app
DigiLocker cloud storage for authentic electronic certificates (Aadhaar, DL, Marksheets)
High speed broadband in gram panchayats via BharatNet
Direct benefit delivery eliminating intermediaries
eligibility: All Indian citizens.
applicationSteps: Download DigiLocker and UMANG apps from App Store / Play Store.
Register using Aadhaar number and OTP verification.
Issue and store digital government documents instantly.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Govt of India

name: प्रधानमंत्री जनजातीय उन्नत ग्राम अभियान (PM-JUGA)
name_en: Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Unnat Gram Abhiyan

hi.name: पीएम जनजातीय उन्नत ग्राम अभियान
hi.shortDescription: 63,000 से अधिक आदिवासी गांवों में पक्के मकान, स्वच्छ पेयजल, बिजली व आजीविका का समग्र विकास।

description: देश के 549 जिलों के 63,843 जनजातीय बहुल गांवों में 5 करोड़ से अधिक आदिवासी नागरिकों के जीवन स्तर में सुधार हेतु 17 मंत्रालयों के 25 प्रमुख हस्तक्षेपों (पक्के मकान, ऑल-वेदर रोड, हर घर नल से जल, विद्युतीकरण, कौशल केंद्र) का समग्र विकास अभियान।
shortDescription: Mission-mode development program transforming 63,843 tribal majority villages covering over 5 Crore tribal citizens.
benefits: 100% saturation of PMAY-G houses and tap water connections in tribal hamlets
Solar off-grid power for unelectrified remote tribal villages
Tribal Home Stays support (₹5 Lakh grant per household) for eco-tourism
Mobile health units and specialized sickle cell screening camps
eligibility: Residents of notified tribal majority villages and Scheduled Tribe households across participating states.
applicationSteps: Village saturation plan executed by District Collector and Tribal Welfare Department.
Gram Sabha verifies household saturation lists.
Direct benefit delivery via converged departmental schemes.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Govt of India

name: पीएम-जनमन योजना (PM-JANMAN)
name_en: PM-JANMAN (Pradhan Mantri Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan)

hi.name: पीएम-जनमन योजना
hi.shortDescription: विशेष रूप से कमजोर जनजातीय समूहों (PVTGs) को आवास, सड़क, स्वच्छ जल व बुनियादी सुविधाएं।

description: विशेष रूप से कमजोर जनजातीय समूहों (PVTG) के 28 लाख से अधिक परिवारों को मुख्यधारा से जोड़ने और 11 महत्वपूर्ण क्षेत्रों (पक्के आवास, सड़क, पेयजल, मोबाइल मेडिकल यूनिट, कौशल केंद्र, सौर विद्युतीकरण) में बुनियादी सुविधाएं प्रदान करने की ₹24,000 करोड़ की महा-योजना।
shortDescription: Comprehensive ₹24,000 Crore mission addressing critical infrastructure, housing, health, and livelihood needs of 75 PVTG communities.
benefits: Pucca houses under PMAY-G with enhanced unit cost of ₹2.00 Lakh
Clean tap water, road connectivity, and off-grid solar power systems
Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVK) for processing minor forest produce
Hostels for PVTG students and mobile medical clinics
eligibility: Households belonging to 75 recognized Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) residing in 18 states and UTs.
applicationSteps: Special saturation camps organized directly in PVTG habitations.
Aadhaar enrollment and Jan Dhan bank accounts opened at doorstep.
Sanction letters for housing, water, and electrification distributed by district teams.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Govt of India

name: प्रधानमंत्री उच्चतर शिक्षा प्रोत्साहन योजना (PM-USP)

hi.name: प्रधानमंत्री उच्चतर शिक्षा प्रोत्साहन योजना
hi.shortDescription: कॉलेज व विश्वविद्यालय छात्रों को उच्च शिक्षा हेतु ₹12,000 से ₹20,000 वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति।

description: मेधावी छात्रों को उच्च शिक्षण संस्थानों (कॉलेज एवं विश्वविद्यालय) में स्नातक एवं स्नातकोत्तर पाठ्यक्रमों में अध्ययन हेतु वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करने वाली केंद्रीय छात्रवृत्ति योजना।
shortDescription: Central sector scholarship of ₹12,000/year for graduation and ₹20,000/year for post-graduation for meritorious college students.
benefits: ₹12,000 per year at graduation level for first 3 years
₹20,000 per year at post-graduation level
Direct DBT transfer into student's Aadhaar-linked bank account
eligibility: Students above 80th percentile of successful candidates in Class 12 board examination enrolled in recognized regular college/university degree. Family annual income less than ₹4.5 Lakh.
applicationSteps: Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Select 'Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students'.
Institute nodal officer verifies enrollment.
State education department processes merit list.
Scholarship credited directly via DBT.
officialDepartment: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Govt of India

name: राष्ट्रीय साधन-सह-योग्यता छात्रवृत्ति योजना (NMMSS)

hi.name: राष्ट्रीय साधन-सह-योग्यता छात्रवृत्ति
hi.shortDescription: कक्षा 9 से 12 तक के मेधावी व आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर छात्रों को ₹12,000 प्रति वर्ष छात्रवृत्ति।

description: आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्गों के प्रतिभाशाली विद्यार्थियों को कक्षा 8 के बाद पढ़ाई छोड़ने से रोकने तथा कक्षा 9 से 12 तक माध्यमिक स्तर पर अध्ययन जारी रखने हेतु ₹12,000 प्रति वर्ष की छात्रवृत्ति प्रदान करने की केंद्रीय योजना।
shortDescription: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) for classes 9 to 12 for meritorious students from economically weaker sections.
benefits: ₹12,000 per year from Class 9 to Class 12 (Total ₹48,000 across 4 years)
Direct DBT transfer into student's personal bank account
Arrests dropout rate of brilliant students in rural and low-income families
eligibility: Students studying in Class 8 in Govt, Govt-aided or Local body schools who scored 55%+ in Class 7 and qualify NMMS state screening test. Family income below ₹3.5 Lakh.
documents: NMMS Examination Admit Card / Rank Card
applicationSteps: Appear in State Level NMMS Selection Exam (Mental Ability Test + Scholastic Aptitude Test).
After qualifying merit list, register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
School verifies application online.
Disbursement of ₹12,000 yearly via PFMS DBT.
officialDepartment: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education, Govt of India

name: पीएम यशस्वी योजना (PM YASASVI)
name_en: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India
description: अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग (OBC), आर्थिक रूप से पिछड़े वर्ग (EBC) और विमुक्त एवं घुमंतू जनजातियों (DNT) के उत्कृष्ट विद्यार्थियों को शीर्ष स्कूलों में कक्षा 9 से 12 तक उच्च गुणवत्तापूर्ण शिक्षा हेतु पूर्ण छात्रवृत्ति प्रदान करने की योजना।
shortDescription: Top class school scholarship of ₹75,000/year (Class 9-10) and ₹1,25,000/year (Class 11-12) for OBC, EBC, and DNT students.
benefits: Class 9 and 10 students receive up to ₹75,000 per year covering school tuition and hostel fees
Class 11 and 12 students receive up to ₹1,25,000 per year
Top-class college education scholarships also covered under higher component
eligibility: Students belonging to OBC, EBC, or DNT categories enrolled in identified top-schools. Family annual income not exceeding ₹2.5 Lakh.
applicationSteps: Apply through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Select PM-YASASVI Top Class Education in Schools scheme.
Upload caste and income credentials.
School and District Nodal Officer verify credentials.
Scholarship disbursed directly through PFMS.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt of India

name: स्वयं (SWAYAM)
name_en: SWAYAM - Study Webs of Active-Learning for Young Aspiring Minds

hi.name: स्वयं ऑनलाइन शिक्षा मंच
hi.shortDescription: आईआईटी, आईआईएम व शीर्ष प्राध्यापकों द्वारा 9वीं से पोस्ट-ग्रेजुएशन तक निःशुल्क ऑनलाइन पाठ्यक्रम व क्रेडिट ट्रांसफर।

description: भारत सरकार के शिक्षा मंत्रालय द्वारा संचालित राष्ट्रीय ऑनलाइन लर्निंग पोर्टल, जिस पर कक्षा 9 से लेकर पोस्ट-ग्रेजुएशन स्तर तक के 3,000 से अधिक पाठ्यक्रमों की उच्च गुणवत्तायुक्त शिक्षा देश के शीर्ष प्राध्यापकों (IITs, IIMs, IISc, IGNOU) द्वारा निःशुल्क उपलब्ध कराई जाती है।
shortDescription: India's national MOOC platform offering free interactive online courses with academic credit transfer facility under UGC/AICTE norms.
benefits: Free access to video lectures, reading materials, self-assessment tests, and online discussion forums
Earn verifiable certificates from IITs, IIMs, and Central Universities upon proctored exam
Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) integration allowing transfer of up to 40% course credits into university degrees
Free learning across Engineering, Science, Humanities, Management, and Law
eligibility: Open to all students, teachers, professionals, and lifelong learners across India and the world.
documents: Aadhaar Card / Student ID (for examination registration)
