applicationSteps: Visit swayam.gov.in and click 'Sign In / Register'.
Browse course catalog by subject or national coordinator (NPTEL, AICTE, UGC, CEC, IGNOU).
Click 'Join' to enroll in any course 100% free of charge.
Watch weekly video lectures and submit online assignments.
Optional: Pay nominal fee of ₹1,000 for appearing in proctored exam to earn official certificate.
officialDepartment: Ministry of Education, Govt of India

name: मुख्यमंत्री कन्या सुमंगला योजना (UP)

hi.name: मुख्यमंत्री कन्या सुमंगला योजना
hi.shortDescription: उत्तर प्रदेश की बालिकाओं को जन्म से स्नातक तक 6 चरणों में ₹25,000 की वित्तीय सहायता।

description: उत्तर प्रदेश सरकार द्वारा बालिकाओं के जन्म, टीकाकरण, प्राथमिक, माध्यमिक एवं उच्च शिक्षा में प्रवेश पर कुल ₹25,000 की वित्तीय सहायता 6 किस्तों में सीधे बैंक खाते में प्रदान की जाती है।
shortDescription: Conditional cash grant of ₹25,000 disbursed across 6 developmental milestones from birth to graduation for girls in Uttar Pradesh.
benefits: Disbursement of ₹25,000 in 6 stages (Birth: ₹5,000, Immunization: ₹2,000, Class 1: ₹3,000, Class 6: ₹3,000, Class 9: ₹5,000, Graduation: ₹7,000)
Direct DBT transfer into mother/girl's bank account
Eliminates female foeticide and promotes girl child education
eligibility: Resident of Uttar Pradesh. Family annual income less than ₹3,00,000. Maximum 2 girls per family.
applicationSteps: Apply on mksy.up.gov.in portal.
Select milestone stage and upload supporting certificates.
Block Development Officer (BDO) / SDM verifies application.
Grant credited to bank account via DBT.
officialDepartment: Women and Child Development Department, Govt of Uttar Pradesh

name: मुख्यमंत्री माझी लाड़की बहिन योजना (Maharashtra)
name_en: Mukhya Mantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana

hi.name: मुख्यमंत्री माझी लाड़की बहिन योजना
hi.shortDescription: महाराष्ट्र की 21 से 65 वर्ष की पात्र महिलाओं को ₹1,500 प्रतिमाह प्रत्यक्ष आर्थिक सहायता।

description: महाराष्ट्र राज्य की 21 से 65 वर्ष आयु वर्ग की पात्र महिलाओं के आर्थिक स्वावलंबन, स्वास्थ्य और पोषण में सुधार हेतु ₹1,500 प्रति माह (₹18,000 वार्षिक) की प्रत्यक्ष वित्तीय सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में प्रदान करने की प्रमुख योजना।
shortDescription: Direct monthly financial support of ₹1,500 to women residents of Maharashtra to promote health, nutrition, and self-reliance.
benefits: Direct DBT transfer of ₹1,500 per month into beneficiary bank account
Financial security and independence for day-to-day household and health expenses
eligibility: Resident woman of Maharashtra aged 21 to 65 years. Family annual income less than ₹2.5 Lakh. Holder of yellow or orange ration card.
applicationSteps: Apply through Nari Shakti Doot App or ladkibahin.maharashtra.gov.in.
Submit Aadhaar, Ration Card and income proof.
Verification by local municipal / taluka committee.
Monthly payout disbursed directly to bank account.
officialDepartment: Women and Child Development Department, Govt of Maharashtra

name: मुख्यमंत्री आयुष्मान आरोग्य योजना (Rajasthan)

hi.name: मुख्यमंत्री आयुष्मान आरोग्य योजना
hi.shortDescription: राजस्थान के परिवारों को ₹25 लाख तक का कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य बीमा एवं ₹5 लाख का दुर्घटना बीमा।

description: राजस्थान के सभी परिवारों को गंभीर बीमारियों के इलाज हेतु सरकारी एवं संबद्ध निजी चिकित्सालयों में ₹25 लाख तक का कैशलेस इनडोर उपचार तथा ₹5 लाख का दुर्घटना बीमा कवर प्रदान करने की योजना।
shortDescription: Universal health coverage providing cashless medical treatment up to ₹25 Lakh and ₹5 Lakh accident insurance for families in Rajasthan.
benefits: Cashless medical treatment up to ₹25,00,000 per family per year
Accidental death and permanent disability cover of ₹5,00,000
Free for NFSA, SECC, small/marginal farmers, and contractual workers
eligibility: Permanent resident families of Rajasthan possessing Jan Aadhaar Card.
incomeLimit: Universal in Rajasthan (nominal premium for non-eligible)
applicationSteps: Verify registration on chiranjeevi.rajasthan.gov.in using Jan Aadhaar ID.
Download Chiranjeevi Policy Document.
Show Jan Aadhaar at helpdesk of empanelled hospital for cashless hospitalization.
officialDepartment: Department of Medical, Health and Family Welfare, Govt of Rajasthan

name: मुख्यमंत्री कन्या उत्थान योजना (Bihar)

hi.name: मुख्यमंत्री कन्या उत्थान योजना
hi.shortDescription: बिहार की छात्राओं को जन्म से स्नातक तक कुल ₹54,100 तथा स्नातक पास करने पर ₹50,000 एकमुश्त।

description: बाल विवाह रोकने, लिंगानुपात में सुधार लाने और बालिकाओं को उच्च शिक्षा हेतु प्रेरित करने हेतु बिहार सरकार द्वारा जन्म से स्नातक तक विभिन्न चरणों में वित्तीय सहायता तथा स्नातक पास करने पर ₹50,000 की एकमुश्त प्रोत्साहन राशि दी जाती है।
shortDescription: Cumulative incentive of ₹54,100 from birth to graduation, with ₹50,000 one-time incentive for girls completing graduation in Bihar.
benefits: ₹50,000 direct bank grant on passing Graduation from recognized university in Bihar
₹25,000 incentive for unmarried girls passing Intermediate (12th)
Funds directly credited into girl's personal bank account
eligibility: Resident girl student of Bihar who graduated from a recognized university in Bihar. Intermediate component for unmarried girls.
documents: Graduation Final Year Marksheet & Registration Number
applicationSteps: Apply on MedhaSoft portal medhasoft.bih.nic.in.
Enter University Registration Number and roll number.
University verifies degree authenticity online.
State Treasury transfers ₹50,000 directly via DBT.
officialDepartment: Education Department, Govt of Bihar

name: गृह लक्ष्मी योजना (Karnataka)

hi.name: गृह लक्ष्मी योजना
hi.shortDescription: कर्नाटक के परिवारों की महिला मुखिया को ₹2,000 प्रति माह प्रत्यक्ष वित्तीय सहायता।

description: कर्नाटक राज्य में परिवार की महिला मुखिया (गृहणी) को आर्थिक स्वावलंबन और सम्मानजनक जीवन प्रदान करने के उद्देश्य से ₹2,000 प्रति माह (₹24,000 वार्षिक) की प्रत्यक्ष वित्तीय सहायता बैंक खाते में उपलब्ध कराने की गारंटी योजना।
shortDescription: Direct monthly cash assistance of ₹2,000 to the woman head of every eligible household in Karnataka.
benefits: Monthly DBT of ₹2,000 into woman head of family's bank account
Aids household food security, children education, and healthcare needs
eligibility: Woman designated as head of household in Karnataka ration card (Antyodaya, BPL, or APL). Woman or her husband must not be an income-tax or GST payer.
documents: Karnataka Ration Card (BPL / APL / AAY) showing woman as head of family
Aadhaar Card of woman and husband
applicationSteps: Apply through Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in) or visit Karnataka One / Grama One centre.
Submit Ration Card number and Aadhaar biometric verification.
Acknowledgment receipt generated.
Monthly ₹2,000 transferred via DBT.
officialDepartment: Department of Women and Child Development, Govt of Karnataka
